systems.system: NIMC national identity database and API
systems.platform: identity database with an application programming interface for agencies

NGA.note: The story describes the identity system's own API and agency integrations, not a platform exchanging data between public bodies' systems.

facts.fact: NIMC's Alvan Ikoku said about 63 government agencies had integrated with NIMC, including bodies in examinations, student finance, consumer credit and health insurance, through its API for verification services; the story dates it to the 2026-10-14 briefing.
The story names integrated agencies in examinations, student finance, consumer credit and health insurance as part of the roughly 63 connected to NIMC, per NIMC at the 2026-10-14 briefing.
NIMC said about 63 government agencies had integrated with it and that 142 million people held NINs as of September 2026; no count of verifications is given.

systems.platform: API offered by NIMC to agencies and licensed partners for verification
